shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated pattern (zigzag/chevron and row of small units)
rows of small repeated signs or motifs in register-like bands
carved relief on pale weathered stone
blue sky as background at upper edge
justification: Both surfaces organise small repeated motifs into horizontal bands above or beside larger profile creatures, and both include discs and a bird-like head in profile, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a densely packed field of fine, shallow sunk-relief signs covering a broad wall, whereas B is a narrow upright block with a few bold, high-relief animals and much empty ground, so the manner of carving, scale and density are quite unlike.
